<analysis>
Let me chronologically analyze the conversation:

1. The conversation starts with a teammate message from "team-lead" asking me to analyze the entire codebase of an Elasticsearch custom Korean morphological analyzer plugin. The project is at `/Users/admin/project/analysis-danuri`.

2. I was asked to:
   - Analyze all classes in each package and document their roles/responsibilities
   - Map class inheritance and interface implementation relationships
   - Document core data flow: text input → morphological analysis → token output
   - Document Dictionary system's load/cache/reload mechanism
   - Document ES plugin lifecycle and integration points
   - Identify Kotlin migration risk points (null handling, mutable state, generics, static methods, checked exceptions)
   - Produce an architecture analysis report

3. I started by:
   - Setting task #1 to in_progress
   - Listing all Java source files (found 63 .java files)
   - Trying to activate Serena project (succeeded)
   - Trying to use Serena's get_symbols_overview (returned empty {} for all files - Java LSP not indexed)
   - Fell back to reading files directly

4. I read ALL source files across all packages:
   - `com.danawa.io` package (6 files): DataInput, DataOutput, BytesBuffer, CachedCharArray, InputStreamDataInput, OutputStreamDataOutput
   - `com.danawa.util` package (4 files): CharVector, ContextStore, ResourceResolver, SystemDictionaryCompiler
   - `com.danawa.search.analysis.dict` package (15 files): Dictionary, SourceDictionary, ReadableDictionary, WritableDictionary, ReloadableDictionary, CommonDictionary, ProductNameDictionary, TagProbDictionary, SetDictionary, MapDictionary, SynonymDictionary, CompoundDictionary, CustomDictionary, SpaceDictionary, InvertMapDictionary
   - `com.danawa.search.analysis.korean` package (4 files): KoreanWordExtractor, MorphUtil, PosTagProbEntry, PreResult
   - `com.danawa.search.analysis.product` package (12 files): AnalysisProductNamePlugin, ProductNameTokenizer, ProductNameTokenizerFactory, ProductNameAnalyzer, ProductNameAnalyzerProvider, ProductNameAnalysisFilter, ProductNameAnalysisFilterFactory, ProductNameAnalysisAction, ProductNameParsingRule, AnalyzerOption, AnalyzeExceedException
   - `com.danawa.search.analysis.product.action` package: RestReloadDictAction, TransportReloadDictAction
   - `com.danawa.search.analysis.product.rule` package: Rule, Entry, RuleEntry (partial reads of RuleOne-RuleFive not done yet)
   - `org.apache.lucene.analysis.tokenattributes` package: TokenInfoAttribute, ExtraTermAttribute, SynonymAttribute

5. Files I did NOT read yet:
   - TokenInfoAttributeImpl, ExtraTermAttributeImpl, SynonymAttributeImpl
   - RuleOne, RuleTwo, RuleThree, RuleFour, RuleFive (only Rule base class and Entry/RuleEntry)
   - TermHighlightingQuery
   - DanawaBulkTextIndexer, DanawaSearchQueryBuilder, FastcatMigrateIndexer
   - SearchUtil, RemoteNodeClient
   - ReloadDictNodeRequest, ReloadDictNodeResponse, ReloadDictNodesRequest, ReloadDictNodesResponse
   - Tester.java

6. The task was interrupted by the summary request before I could:
   - Complete reading all remaining files
   - Produce the architecture analysis report
   - Send the report to the team lead
   - Mark task #1 as completed

Let me now document the key architectural findings from what I've read.

Key Architecture:
- ES Plugin: AnalysisProductNamePlugin extends Plugin implements AnalysisPlugin, ActionPlugin
- Pipeline: ProductNameTokenizer → ProductNameAnalysisFilter
- Factory pattern: ProductNameTokenizerFactory, ProductNameAnalysisFilterFactory, ProductNameAnalyzerProvider
- Dictionary hierarchy: Dictionary<T,P> interface → TagProbDictionary (system dict), SourceDictionary<E> abstract (user dicts) → SetDictionary, MapDictionary → SynonymDictionary, SpaceDictionary, CompoundDictionary, InvertMapDictionary, CustomDictionary
- Korean word extraction: KoreanWordExtractor uses tabular parsing with PosTagProbEntry
- Rule engine: Rule abstract → RuleOne through RuleFive, applied sequentially in ProductNameParsingRule
- ContextStore: singleton-per-class storage using ConcurrentHashMap
- Custom I/O: DataInput/DataOutput for binary dictionary serialization
- Lucene custom attributes: TokenInfoAttribute, ExtraTermAttribute, SynonymAttribute

Current task list status:

- #2 (completed): 형태소분석 패턴/공백 처리 이슈 분석
- #3 (in_progress): Java → Kotlin 코드 마이그레이션
- #4 (pending): Kotlin 코드 성능 리뷰 및 리팩토링
- #5 (pending): Elasticsearch 플러그인 호환성 검토
</analysis>

<summary>
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   The team lead assigned me (code-analyst) to perform a comprehensive architecture analysis of the entire Elasticsearch custom Korean morphological analyzer codebase at `/Users/admin/project/analysis-danuri`. The project is on branch `feautre/kotlin-migration` and contains ~63 Java source files across 11 packages. The analysis should produce:
   - Package-by-package class summary (one-line descriptions)
   - Inheritance/interface relationship diagram
   - Core data flow documentation
   - Kotlin migration risk points
   - Final report sent to team lead via SendMessage, then mark Task #1 as completed

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Elasticsearch 9.1.2 custom analysis plugin (AnalysisPlugin + ActionPlugin)
   - Lucene Tokenizer/TokenFilter pipeline architecture
   - Korean morphological analysis using tabular parsing (CYK-like algorithm)
   - POS tag probability-based word segmentation
   - Binary dictionary serialization/deserialization (custom DataInput/DataOutput)
   - Dictionary hierarchy: system dictionary (TagProbDictionary) + user dictionaries (Set, Map, Synonym, Space, Custom, InvertMap, Compound)
   - Dictionary reload mechanism via ContextStore singleton pattern
   - ES Transport Action for cluster-wide dictionary reload
   - Rule-based product name parsing (5 sequential rules)
   - Custom Lucene token attributes (TokenInfoAttribute, ExtraTermAttribute, SynonymAttribute)
   - CharVector as core text representation (mutable, supports ignoreCase)

3. Files and Code Sections:

   **com.danawa.io package (I/O utilities):**
   - `DataInput.java` - Abstract base for reading binary data types (byte, short, int, long, VInt, VLong, String, Map, generic values). Extends InputStream, implements Cloneable. Custom UTF-8 and UString (2-byte per char) encoding.
   - `DataOutput.java` - Abstract base for writing binary data types. Extends OutputStream. Mirrors DataInput for serialization.
   - `BytesBuffer.java` - Byte buffer with offset/limit tracking, NIO-like flip/clear semantics. Public mutable fields (bytes, offset, limit).
   - `CachedCharArray.java` - ThreadLocal-based char[] cache using SoftReference for reuse during string reading.
   - `InputStreamDataInput.java` - Concrete DataInput wrapping a plain InputStream.
   - `OutputStreamDataOutput.java` - Concrete DataOutput wrapping a plain OutputStream.

   **com.danawa.util package (utilities):**
   - `CharVector.java` - Core text representation class. Implements CharSequence, Comparable, Serializable. Supports ignoreCase mode (uppercase comparison), whitespace handling, trim, split. Mutable internal state (array, offset, length, hash). **Critical Kotlin migration risk**: mutable state, hash invalidation, shared array references via clone().
   - `ContextStore.java` - Singleton-per-class global storage using ConcurrentHashMap. Used to share ProductNameDictionary across Tokenizer/Filter/Action components. `getStore(Class<?>)` returns class-keyed store.
   - `ResourceResolver.java` - Utility to find plugin resource root (JAR or workspace) and read properties/YAML config files.
   - `SystemDictionaryCompiler.java` - CLI tool to compile system dictionary (TagProbDictionary) from text source files into binary format.

   **com.danawa.search.analysis.dict package (Dictionary hierarchy):**
   - `Dictionary.java` - Core interface: `Dictionary<T, P>` with `find(CharSequence)`, `findPreResult(CharSequence)`, `setPreDictionary()`, `size()`, `seq()`, `label()`, `appendAdditionalNounEntry()`.
   - `ReadableDictionary.java` - Interface: `readFrom(InputStream)`.
   - `WritableDictionary.java` - Interface: `writeTo(OutputStream)`.
   - `ReloadableDictionary.java` - Interface: `reload(Object)`.
   - `SourceDictionary.java` - Abstract base for user dictionaries. Implements ReloadableDictionary, WritableDictionary, ReadableDictionary. Has label, seq, tokenType, type, ignoreCase. Loads from file/stream via `addSourceLineEntry()`.
   - `CommonDictionary.java` - Container holding system Dictionary + Map<String, SourceDictionary<?>> dictionaryMap. Delegates find() to system dictionary. `reset()` replaces system dictionary reference.
   - `ProductNameDictionary.java` (~754 lines) - **Central orchestrator**. Extends CommonDictionary<TagProb, PreResult<CharSequence>>. Manages dictionary lifecycle: loading from YAML config, creating typed dictionaries, reload mechanism, compile from ES index, restore to ES index. Static baseFile/configFile state. Type enum: SYSTEM, SET, MAP, SYNONYM, SYNONYM_2WAY, SPACE, CUSTOM, INVERT_MAP, COMPOUND. TokenType enum: MAX, HIGH, MID, MIN. Inner class DictionaryRepository (abstract).
   - `TagProbDictionary.java` - System dictionary implementing Dictionary<TagProb, PreResult<CharSequence>>. Stores probMap (CharSequence → List<TagProb>) and preMap. Binary read/write via DataInput/DataOutput. `addSourceEntry()` parses "word\tPOS\tprob" lines.
   - `SetDictionary.java` - Set<CharSequence> storage. Extends SourceDictionary. Binary serialization via writeInt(size) + writeString per entry.
   - `MapDictionary.java` - Map<CharSequence, CharSequence[]> storage. Extends SourceDictionary. Tab-separated key-value input.
   - `SynonymDictionary.java` - Extends MapDictionary. Adds wordSet. Handles bidirectional/unidirectional synonyms. Complex merge logic for duplicate handling.
   - `CompoundDictionary.java` - Extends MapDictionary. Has mainWordSet + wordSet. Stores compound noun decompositions.
   - `SpaceDictionary.java` - Extends MapDictionary. Has wordSet. Handles space-separated compound words (공백처리).
   - `CustomDictionary.java` - Extends SourceDictionary. Map<CharSequence, Object[]> with mixed value types (CharSequence or CharSequence[]).
   - `InvertMapDictionary.java` - Extends MapDictionary. Inverts key-value: each value maps back to the key.

   **com.danawa.search.analysis.korean package (Korean morphology):**
   - `KoreanWordExtractor.java` (~914 lines) - **Core morphological analyzer**. Uses tabular parsing (PosTagProbEntry[][]) with status tracking. `setInput()` → `extract()` pipeline. Handles long input by splitting at type boundaries. Inner class `ExtractedEntry` (linked list of segmented words with PosTag, score, offset). Priority queue-based best-result selection. `isConnectableByRule()` checks 받침-조사 agreement. `QUEUE_MAX=200`, `RESULT_MAX=10`, `fastResultOption` for early termination.
   - `MorphUtil.java` - Korean character decomposition utilities. Static methods for 초성/중성/종성 split/combine, isHangul check, hasLastElement (받침 check).
   - `PosTagProbEntry.java` - Linked list node for POS tag entries. Inner enum `PosTag` (SOE, UNK, N, V, M, IC, J, E, EP, X, ALPHA, XPN, EOE, GUESS, DIGIT, SYMBOL). Inner class `TagProb` with probability constants (MAX_PROB=-5, HIGH_PROB=-8, MID_PROB=-13, LOW_PROB=-14, MIN_PROB=-16). Static singletons: UNK, GUESS, DIGIT, ALPHA, SYMBOL, JOSA.
   - `PreResult.java` - Generic container for pre-analyzed results. Has result[] and addition[] arrays.

   **com.danawa.search.analysis.product package (ES plugin integration):**
   - `AnalysisProductNamePlugin.java` - ES Plugin entry point. Registers "product_name" tokenizer, filter, and analyzer. Registers TransportReloadDictAction and REST handlers (ProductNameAnalysisAction, RestReloadDictAction).
   - `ProductNameTokenizer.java` (~534 lines) - Lucene Tokenizer. Reads from Reader, performs basic tokenization by whitespace/type boundaries, then feeds segments to KoreanWordExtractor for morphological analysis. Defines all type constants (WHITESPACE, SYMBOL, ALPHA, NUMBER, HANGUL, MODEL_NAME, UNIT, etc.). Static `getType(int ch)` classifies characters. `PTN_NUMBER` regex for number validation. IO_BUFFER_SIZE=1000, FULL_TERM_LENGTH=64.
   - `ProductNameAnalysisFilter.java` (~433 lines) - Lucene TokenFilter. Consumes tokens from ProductNameTokenizer, applies ProductNameParsingRule, handles synonym expansion, stop word filtering, extra term extraction. Different behavior for query vs index mode. Manages termList queue of RuleEntry objects.
   - `ProductNameAnalysisFilterFactory.java` - ES factory. Reads settings (use_for_query, use_synonym, use_stopword, use_full_string). Creates ProductNameAnalysisFilter instances.
   - `ProductNameTokenizerFactory.java` - ES factory. Loads dictionary from ContextStore or Environment. Creates ProductNameTokenizer instances.
   - `ProductNameAnalyzer.java` - Lucene Analyzer. Creates pipeline: ProductNameTokenizer → ProductNameAnalysisFilter.
   - `ProductNameAnalyzerProvider.java` - ES analyzer provider. Static `getAnalyzer()` method creates TokenStream for on-demand analysis.
   - `AnalyzerOption.java` - Configuration POJO: useForQuery, useSynonym, useStopword, useFullString, toUppercase.
   - `ProductNameParsingRule.java` - Rule engine orchestrator. Applies 5 rules sequentially: RuleOne (classification) → RuleTwo (type changes) → RuleThree (unit extraction) → RuleFour (model name extraction) → RuleFive (exception rules). Cloneable for synonym analysis.
   - `ProductNameAnalysisAction.java` (~1857 lines) - **Largest file**. REST handler for `/_analysis-product-name/{action}`. Supports: test, reload-dict, info-dict, find-dict, restore-dict, compile-dict, full-index, fastcat-index, analyze, search, build-query, get-synonym-list, multi-analyze, search-keyword, check-dict. Inner class `DictionarySource` extends DictionaryRepository.
   - `AnalyzeExceedException.java` - Custom exception for analysis queue overflow.

   **com.danawa.search.analysis.product.action package (Transport actions):**
   - `RestReloadDictAction.java` - REST handler for `/_analysis-product-name/reload-dict`. Delegates to TransportReloadDictAction via client.execute().
   - `TransportReloadDictAction.java` - ES 9.1.2 TransportNodesAction for cluster-wide dictionary reload. `nodeOperation()` calls `ProductNameDictionary.reloadDictionary()` on each node.

   **com.danawa.search.analysis.product.rule package:**
   - `Rule.java` - Abstract base for parsing rules. Contains dictionary references, helper methods (isEntryType, isConnected, etc.).
   - `Entry.java` - Static utility for entry manipulation (merge, split, addEntry). (Only first 50 lines read.)
   - `RuleEntry.java` - Data class for parsed tokens: buf, start, length, startOffset, endOffset, type, modifiable, synonym[], subEntry[]. Implements Comparable by offset.
   - RuleOne through RuleFive - NOT YET READ.

   **org.apache.lucene.analysis.tokenattributes package (Custom Lucene attributes):**
   - `TokenInfoAttribute.java` - Interface: ref (CharVector), posTag, state flags (READY, BUFFER_EXHAUSTED, INPUT_FINISHED, TERM_STOP), dictionary reference, baseOffset.
   - `ExtraTermAttribute.java` - Interface: addExtraTerm(term, type, synonyms), iterator().
   - `SynonymAttribute.java` - Interface: setSynonyms(List<CharSequence>), getSynonyms().
   - Impl classes NOT YET READ.

   **Files NOT yet read:**
   - `TermHighlightingQuery.java`
   - `DanawaBulkTextIndexer.java`, `DanawaSearchQueryBuilder.java`, `FastcatMigrateIndexer.java`
   - `SearchUtil.java`, `RemoteNodeClient.java`
   - `ReloadDictNodeRequest.java`, `ReloadDictNodeResponse.java`, `ReloadDictNodesRequest.java`, `ReloadDictNodesResponse.java`
   - `TokenInfoAttributeImpl.java`, `ExtraTermAttributeImpl.java`, `SynonymAttributeImpl.java`
   - `RuleOne.java`, `RuleTwo.java`, `RuleThree.java`, `RuleFour.java`, `RuleFive.java`
   - `Tester.java`

4. Errors and fixes:
   - Serena's `get_symbols_overview` returned empty `{}` for all Java files - Java LSP was not yet indexed. Fixed by falling back to direct file reading with the Read tool instead of relying on Serena's symbolic analysis tools.
   - No user feedback errors occurred.

5. Problem Solving:
   - Successfully read and analyzed the majority of the codebase (~50+ files)
   - Identified the complete architecture: ES Plugin → Tokenizer → Filter → Rule Engine pipeline
   - Mapped the Dictionary inheritance hierarchy
   - Identified key Kotlin migration risks (mutable CharVector state, static fields in ProductNameDictionary, checked exceptions, null patterns)
   - Still need to: read remaining files, produce formal report, send to team lead

6. All user messages:
   - Team lead message: "당신은 이 프로젝트의 코드 분석가입니다. Elasticsearch 커스텀 한글 형태소분석기의 전체 코드베이스를 분석해주세요." with detailed instructions covering package-by-package analysis, core analysis points (inheritance, data flow, dictionary system, ES lifecycle, Kotlin migration risks), and deliverables (architecture analysis report to team lead).

7. Pending Tasks:
   - Complete reading remaining unread files (RuleOne-RuleFive, Impl classes, util classes, index classes, highlight, action request/response classes)
   - Produce the formal architecture analysis report with:
     - Package-by-package class summary
     - Inheritance/interface relationship diagram
     - Core data flow documentation
     - Kotlin migration risk points
   - Send report to team lead via SendMessage
   - Mark Task #1 as completed via TaskUpdate

8. Current Work:
   I was in the process of reading all source files to complete the architecture analysis. I had just finished reading the last batch of files (AnalyzeExceedException, Rule, Entry partial, RuleEntry, RestReloadDictAction, TransportReloadDictAction, TokenInfoAttribute, ExtraTermAttribute, SynonymAttribute) when the summary was requested. The analysis report has NOT yet been produced or sent to the team lead.

9. Optional Next Step:
   Complete reading the remaining unread files (RuleOne-RuleFive, *Impl classes, SearchUtil, RemoteNodeClient, DanawaBulkTextIndexer, DanawaSearchQueryBuilder, FastcatMigrateIndexer, TermHighlightingQuery, ReloadDict*Request/Response), then produce the comprehensive architecture analysis report and send it to the team lead. The team lead's original instruction was: "분석 완료 후 TaskUpdate로 Task #1을 completed로 변경하고, 팀 리더에게 결과를 SendMessage로 보내주세요."
</summary>
